Booking with Unizerve is quick and simple. You can call us or send a WhatsApp message with your requirement. Whether its appliance repair, plumbing, painting, delivery, or purchase assistance, our team will confirm your booking and schedule a convenient time.

Yes. Unizerve works with skilled and experienced technicians who follow industry safety standards and best practices. We ensure every service  whether repair, maintenance, installation, plumbing, painting, or delivery  is handled professionally and responsibly. Customer safety and service quality are our top priorities.

At Unizerve, our pricing is based on the type of service, job complexity, time required, and any materials or parts needed. We believe in transparent and fair pricing  there are no hidden charges. After understanding your requirement, our team provides a clear estimate before starting the work. For delivery and purchase services, pricing may depend on distance, product type, and urgency.

At Unizerve, the time required depends on the type of service and the complexity of the work. " Minor repairs (AC, fridge, washing machine, mobile, laptop, plumbing, electrical) usually take 12 hours. " Regular maintenance services are typically completed within a few hours. " Larger installations, painting projects, or complex repairs may take longer. " Delivery and purchase services are completed based on distance and availability, usually on the same day.

Unizerve provides repair, maintenance, delivery, and purchase services across your local city and nearby surrounding areas.
